metadata.consistency_ledger:
# CONSISTENCY LEDGER — Southern Welsh (De Cymru) Listening Pod

## TRANSLITERATION
TRANSLITERATION: not needed — names stay as written.

## PRICES
£8.40 → wyth bunt a deugain
£4.50 → pedwar punt a hanner
£5.00 → pump punt
£12.50 → deuddeg punt a hanner

## TARGET-LANGUAGE NAME
Cymraeg (or *yr iaith Gymraeg* when formal context demands; colloquially just *Cymraeg*)

## RECURRING LINES

| Canonical | Southern Welsh (De Cymru) |
|-----------|---------------------------|
| Good morning. What can I get you? | Bore da. Be sai di moyn? |
| I'd like a [item], please. | Licen i [item], os gweli di'n dda. |
| Could I pay by card? Do you have contactless? | Alia i dalu gyda cherdyn? Ti'n cymryd tap? |
| Thank you very much. Goodbye. | Diolch yn fawr iawn. Hwyl. |
| Excuse me. | Os gweli di'n dda. |
| I'm learning Southern Welsh (colloquial De Cymru Welsh). | Dw i'n dysgu Cymraeg. |
| Pleased to meet you. | Neis gweld ti. |
| Are you eating tonight? | Ti'n byta heno? |
| Is everything alright? | Yw popeth yn iawn? |
| Thank you. You've been very helpful. | Diolch. Ti 'di bod yn neis iawn. |
| Yes, of course. | Ie, dim probs. |

## REGISTER

| Relationship | Register | Form |
|--------------|----------|------|
| Customer–café/pub staff | Unmarked polite / warm | *ti* with *os gweli di'n dda*, *diolch* |
| Stranger–stranger (first meeting) | Warm, direct | *ti*; *Neis gweld ti* |
| Stranger–service professional (shop, hotel, taxi, pharmacy) | Polite, helpful | *ti*; *os gweli di'n dda*, *diolch yn fawr* |
| Friend–friend (peer, conversation partner) | Warm, unselfconscious | *ti*; *diolch* carries weight; no over-marking |

sentences.speaker: Neighbour (8 am)
sentences.target_text: Bore da, Sarah!
sentences.known_text: Good morning, Sarah!

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Bore da. Sut wyt ti?
sentences.known_text: Good morning. How are you?

sentences.speaker: Neighbour
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n dda iawn, diolch. Ti'n mynd i'r gwaith?
sentences.known_text: I'm very well, thank you. Are you going to work?

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Ydw… mae diwrnod prysur 'da fi heddiw. Gobeithio cei di ddiwrnod da. Wela i di wedyn.
sentences.known_text: Yes, I've got a busy day today. I hope you have a good day. See you later.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Esgusodwch fi,… ydy'r sedd yma… wedi'i chymryd?
sentences.known_text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

sentences.speaker: Passenger
sentences.target_text: Nac ydy, mae hi'n rhydd. Croeso i chi eistedd.
sentences.known_text: No, it's free. Please, go ahead.

sentences.speaker: Barista (3 pm)
sentences.target_text: Prynhawn da. Beth alla i gael i chi?
sentences.known_text: Good afternoon. What can I get you?

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Prynhawn da. Licen i goffi,… os gwelwch yn dda. Gyda llaeth ond heb siwgr. I fynd.
sentences.known_text: Good afternoon. I'd like a coffee, please. With milk but with no sugar. To take away.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Hwyl.
sentences.known_text: Thank you very much. Goodbye.

sentences.speaker: Friend (7 pm)
sentences.target_text: Helo, noswaith dda!
sentences.known_text: Hello, good evening!

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Helo! Mae'n ddrwg 'da fi… ond alla i ddim siarad… ar hyn o bryd. Ma rhaid i fi fynd adre nawr. Allwn ni siarad fory?
sentences.known_text: Hello! I'm sorry but I can't talk at the moment. I need to go home now. Can we talk tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: Friend
sentences.target_text: Na, mae'n ddrwg 'da fi,… dw i'n brysur fory. Ond gad i ni siarad… ddydd Sadwrn. Wela i di bryd hynny.
sentences.known_text: No, I'm sorry, I'm busy tomorrow. But let's talk on Saturday. See you then.

sentences.speaker: Neighbour (10:30 pm)
sentences.target_text: Noswaith dda, Sarah. Gest ti ddiwrnod hir?
sentences.known_text: Good evening, Sarah. Did you have a long day?

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.target_text: Do, hir iawn. Dw i wedi… blino'n lân nawr. Nos da. Wela i di fory.
sentences.known_text: Yes, very. I'm absolutely exhausted now. Good night. I'll see you tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.target_text: Esgusodwch fi. Helo. Beth yw eich enw chi?
sentences.known_text: Excuse me. Hello. What's your name?

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.target_text: Anna yw fy enw i. A chi?
sentences.known_text: My name is Anna. And you?

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.target_text: James dw i. Neis cwrdd â chi.
sentences.known_text: I'm James. Pleased to meet you.

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.target_text: Neis cwrdd â chi 'fyd. O ble dych chi'n dod?
sentences.known_text: Pleased to meet you too. Where are you from?

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n dod o Fanceinion,… ond dw i'n byw… yn Llundain nawr. A chi?
sentences.known_text: I'm from Manchester, but I live in London now. And you?

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n dod o Ffrainc. Dw i 'di bod 'ma… ers dwy flynedd.
sentences.known_text: I'm from France. I've been here for two years.

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.target_text: Mae hon yn ddinas hyfryd. Beth dych chi'n neud?
sentences.known_text: This is a lovely city. What do you do?

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.target_text: Nyrs dw i, yn yr ysbyty… jyst rownd y gornel. A chi?
sentences.known_text: I'm a nurse, at the hospital just round the corner. And you?

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.target_text: Mae'n ddrwg 'da fi,… wnes i ddim deall. Dw i'n dysgu Cymraeg. Allwch chi weud 'na 'to,… yn arafach?
sentences.known_text: I'm sorry, I didn't understand you. I'm learning Welsh. Could you say that again more slowly?

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.target_text: Galla, wrth gwrs. Nyrs dw i. Dw i'n gweithio… yn yr ysbyty. Mae e'n agos 'ma. A beth dych chi'n neud?
sentences.known_text: Yes, of course. I'm a nurse. I work at the hospital. It's near here. And what do you do?

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n dysgu Saesneg,… ond ddim mewn ysgol. Dw i'n gweithio… gydag oedolion. Dw i ar wyliau 'ma… gyda fy ngwraig a'r plant. Ry'n ni'n cael… amser hyfryd.
sentences.known_text: I teach English, but not in a school. I work with adults. I'm on holiday here with my wife and children. We're having a lovely time.

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.target_text: Am ddiddorol. Wel, neis cwrdd â chi.
sentences.known_text: How interesting. Well, lovely to meet you.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Un. Dau. Tri. Gwyn. Du.
sentences.known_text: One. Two. Three. White. Black.

sentences.target_text: Bore da. Beth alla i gael i chi?
sentences.known_text: Good morning. What can I get you?

sentences.known_text: Of course. Would you like to sit in or take it away?

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Licen i fynd â fe mas,… os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: I'd like to take it away, please.

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Gallen i gael dau goffi gwyn… a dau goffi du… ac un o rheina… os gwelwch yn dda?
sentences.known_text: Could I have two white coffees and two black coffees and one of those, please?

sentences.speaker: Barista
sentences.target_text: Ar unwaith. Ydych chi moyn rhywbeth arall?
sentences.known_text: Right away. Would you like anything else?

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Ydw,… alla i gael gwydraid o ddŵr… hefyd, os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: Yes, can I have a glass of water as well, please.

sentences.speaker: Barista
sentences.target_text: Wyth punt pedwar deg i gyd.
sentences.known_text: That's eight pound forty altogether.

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Alla i dalu… gyda cherdyn? Oes contactless 'da chi?
sentences.known_text: Could I pay by card? Do you have contactless?

sentences.speaker: Barista
sentences.target_text: Wrth gwrs. Dyma'r peiriant.
sentences.known_text: Of course. There's the machine.

sentences.speaker: Customer 3
sentences.target_text: Bore da. Dau Americano… a chwpaned o de,… os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: Good morning. Two Americanos and a cup of tea, please.

sentences.speaker: Barista
sentences.target_text: Ydych chi moyn eistedd i mewn? Ma'r bwrdd wrth y… ffenest yn rhydd.
sentences.known_text: Would you like to sit in? The table by the window is free.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Pump. Deg. Un deg pump. Coch. Gwyrdd.
sentences.known_text: Five. Ten. Fifteen. Red. Green.

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.target_text: Noswaith dda. Beth alla i gael i chi?
sentences.known_text: Good evening. What can I get you?

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Licen i beint,…os gwelwch yn dda. Pa gwrw casgen sy 'da chi… ar y pwmp?
sentences.known_text: I'd like a pint, please. What ales do you have on?

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.target_text: Ma 'da ni gwrw chwerw… a stout,… a ma'r ddau yn lleol.
sentences.known_text: We've got a bitter and a stout, and they're both local.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Licen i beint o'r cwrw chwerw… os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: I'd like a pint of the bitter, please.

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Alla i gael hanner o seidr?
sentences.known_text: Can I have a half of cider?

sentences.speaker: Customer 3
sentences.target_text: Alla i weld y rhestr win? Dw i moyn gwydraid o win.
sentences.known_text: Can I see the wine list? I want a glass of wine.

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.target_text: Ma 'da ni win coch y tŷ… a gwin gwyn y tŷ,… neu allech chi gael… un o'n poteli ni.
sentences.known_text: We have a house red, a house white, or you could have one of our bottles.

sentences.speaker: Customer 3
sentences.target_text: Licen i wydraid mawr… o win gwyn, os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: I'd like a large glass of white wine, please.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Alla i gael… gwydraid bach o win coch?
sentences.known_text: Can I have a small glass of red wine?

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Licen i… ddau wydraid arall o gwrw.
sentences.known_text: I'd like two more glasses of beer.

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.target_text: Ydych chi'n byta heno?
sentences.known_text: Are you eating tonight?

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Dw i ddim yn siŵr… os dw i'n llwglyd. Oes bwydlen 'da chi?
sentences.known_text: I'm not sure if I'm hungry. Do you have a menu?

sentences.speaker: Bartender
sentences.target_text: Oes, wrth gwrs. Dyma hi. Ma'r pysgod a sglodion… yn dda iawn.
sentences.known_text: Yes, of course. Here it is. The fish and chips are very good.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Allwn ni gael… tipyn o fara? A phowlen o… sglodion i'r bwrdd.
sentences.known_text: Can we have some bread? And a bowl of chips for the table.

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Oes brechdanau 'da chi? Licen i frechdan gaws,… os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: Do you have any sandwiches? I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Pedwar. Chwech. Wyth. Glas. Melyn.
sentences.known_text: Four. Six. Eight. Blue. Yellow.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Noswaith dda. Ma bwcin gyda ni i ddau,… o dan yr enw Davies.
sentences.known_text: Good evening. We have a booking for two, under the name Davies.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Croeso. Dewch gyda fi,… os gwelwch yn dda. Dyma'r bwydlenni.
sentences.known_text: Welcome. Please follow me. Here are the menus.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Licech chi ddŵr llonydd… neu ddŵr pefriog i ddechrau?
sentences.known_text: Would you like still or sparkling water to start?

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Licen ni… un botel o ddŵr pefriog… ac un botel o ddŵr llonydd,… os gwelwch yn dda.
sentences.known_text: We'd like one bottle of sparkling water and one bottle of still water, please.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Esgusodwch fi —… oes gyda chi rywbeth… heb glwten? Neu i lysieuwyr?
sentences.known_text: Excuse me — do you have anything gluten-free? Or for vegetarians?

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Oes… ma'r eog a'r risotto… yn rhydd o glwten. Ma gyda ni rai saladau… hefyd.
sentences.known_text: Yes, the salmon and the risotto are both gluten-free. We also have some salads.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: A beth fyddech… chi'n ei argymell heno?
sentences.known_text: And what would you recommend tonight?

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Ma'r oen yn ardderchog. Ma fe 'di… cael ei goginio'n… araf, gyda rhosmari.
sentences.known_text: The lamb is excellent. It's been slow-cooked, with rosemary.

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Cymra i'r oen,… os gwelwch yn dda. Gyda llysiau gwyrdd… ar yr ochr.
sentences.known_text: I'll have the lamb, please. With a side of greens.

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: A'r risotto i fi. Gyda salad gwyrdd bach… i ddechrau.
sentences.known_text: And the risotto for me. With a small green salad to start.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Wrth gwrs. A beth licech… chi i'w yfed?
sentences.known_text: Of course. And what would you like to drink?

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Allen ni weld y rhestr win?
sentences.known_text: Could we see the wine list?

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: Byddai potel… o win coch y tŷ yn hyfryd.
sentences.known_text: A bottle of the house red would be lovely.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Dewis ardderchog. Do i ag e draw nawr.
sentences.known_text: Excellent choice. I'll bring it right over.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.target_text: Ydy popeth yn iawn? Oes lle gyda chi i bwdin?
sentences.known_text: Is everything alright? Do you have any room for dessert?

sentences.speaker: Customer 1
sentences.target_text: Dim ond dau goffi,… os gwelwch yn dda. Coffi di-gaffein i fi.
sentences.known_text: Just two coffees, please. Decaf for me.

sentences.speaker: Customer 2
sentences.target_text: A'r bil… pan fyddwch chi'n barod. Allen ni rannu fe?
sentences.known_text: And the bill, when you're ready. Could we split it?

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Saith. Naw. Un deg un. Oren. Porffor.
sentences.known_text: Seven. Nine. Eleven. Orange. Purple.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Esgusodwch fi. Oes gyda chi… unrhyw dabledi lladd poen?
sentences.known_text: Excuse me. Do you have any painkillers?

sentences.speaker: Assistant
sentences.target_text: Oes, ma nhw lawr yr eil yna… ar y chwith.
sentences.known_text: Yes, they're down that aisle, on the left.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Diolch. A oes gyda chi unrhyw… dabledi lladd poen i blant?
sentences.known_text: Thank you. And do you have any painkillers for children?

sentences.speaker: Assistant
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n meddwl… bod rhai 'da ni,… ond bydd rhaid i chi edrych… i fod yn siŵr.
sentences.known_text: I think so, but you'll have to look to make sure.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Ma ishe i fi gael… rhywfaint o eli haul… a phast dannedd hefyd.
sentences.known_text: I also need to get some sunscreen and some toothpaste.

sentences.speaker: Assistant
sentences.target_text: Ma'r eli haul lawr fan'na… ar y dde,… a gewch chi hyd… i'r past dannedd… jyst rownd y gornel.
sentences.known_text: Sunscreen is down there on your right, and you'll find toothpaste just round the corner.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Diolch,… dych chi wedi bod yn help mawr. Dw i'n ddiolchgar iawn.
sentences.known_text: Thank you, you've been very helpful. I'm very grateful.

sentences.speaker: Assistant
sentences.target_text: Croeso. Ydych chi yma ar wyliau? Dych chi'n siarad… Cymraeg da iawn.
sentences.known_text: You're welcome. Are you here on holiday? You speak very good Welsh.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Dych chi'n garedig iawn! Ydw, dw i ar wyliau,… ac ma ishe… i fi ymarfer mwy… i siarad Cymraeg yn well. Diolch yn fawr iawn, a hwyl.
sentences.known_text: That's very kind of you! Yes, I'm on holiday, and I need to practise more to speak Welsh better. Thank you very much, and goodbye.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Un deg dau. Un deg tri. Un deg pedwar. Pinc. Llwyd.
sentences.known_text: Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen. Pink. Grey.

sentences.speaker: Guest
sentences.target_text: Prynhawn da. Ma bwcin 'da fi… dan yr enw Jones.
sentences.known_text: Good afternoon. I have a booking under the name Jones.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.target_text: Croeso. Oes, ma 'da chi stafell ddwbl… am dair noson. Ga i weld rhyw fath o ID,… os gwelwch yn dda?
sentences.known_text: Welcome. Yes, you have a double room for three nights. Could I see some ID, please?

sentences.speaker: Guest
sentences.target_text: Wrth gwrs. Dyma fy mhasbort i.
sentences.known_text: Of course. Here's my passport.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.target_text: Bendigedig. Ma'r stafell ar… y trydydd llawr,… stafell saith cant a naw.
sentences.known_text: Lovely. The room is on the third floor, room seven hundred and nine.

sentences.speaker: Guest
sentences.target_text: Oes golygfa 'da'r stafell?
sentences.known_text: Does the room have a view?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.target_text: Oes… ma hi'n edrych dros yr ardd.
sentences.known_text: Yes, it overlooks the garden.

sentences.speaker: Guest
sentences.target_text: Am faint o'r gloch… ma brecwast yn… ca'l ei weini?
sentences.known_text: What time is breakfast served?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.target_text: O hanner awr wedi saith… tan ddeg o'r gloch. Ma 'da ni ffrwythau a grawnfwyd… neu frecwast… wedi'i goginio.
sentences.known_text: From half past seven until ten o'clock. We have fruit and cereals or a cooked breakfast.

sentences.speaker: Guest
sentences.target_text: Gwych. Ydy hi'n bosib… i ni ga'l check-out hwyr?
sentences.known_text: Wonderful. Is it possible for us to have a late check-out?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.target_text: Ydy, gallwch chi aros… tan ganol dydd,… dim tâl ychwanegol.
sentences.known_text: Yes, you can stay until midday, no extra charge.

sentences.speaker: Guest
sentences.target_text: A beth yw cyfrinair… y wifi?
sentences.known_text: And what is the wifi password?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.target_text: Ma fe ar y cerdyn croeso… yn eich stafell chi. Mwynhewch eich arhosiad.
sentences.known_text: It's on the welcome card in your room. Have a lovely stay.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Un deg chwech. Un deg saith. Un deg wyth. Dydd Llun. Dydd Mawrth.
sentences.known_text: Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Monday. Tuesday.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Bore da. Dw i ddim yn… teimlo'n dda iawn… — allwch chi argymell rhywbeth?
sentences.known_text: Good morning. I'm not feeling very well — could you recommend something?

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.target_text: Wrth gwrs. Beth yw eich symptomau chi?
sentences.known_text: Of course. What are your symptoms?

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Dw i 'di bod â phen tost… a gwddw tost ers ddoe.
sentences.known_text: I've had a headache and a sore throat since yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.target_text: Triwch barasetamol… ar gyfer y pen tost,…a'r losin 'ma… ar gyfer y gwddw.
sentences.known_text: Try paracetamol for the headache, and these lozenges for the throat.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Pa mor aml ddylwn i gymryd… y parasetamol?
sentences.known_text: How often should I take the paracetamol?

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.target_text: Un bob pedair i chwe awr,… dim mwy nag wyth mewn diwrnod.
sentences.known_text: One every four to six hours, no more than eight in a day.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Ydy hi'n iawn eu… cymryd nhw gyda bwyd?
sentences.known_text: Are they all right to take with food?

sentences.speaker: Pharmacist
sentences.target_text: Ydy, gyda bwyd… neu ar ôl bwyd sydd orau.
sentences.known_text: Yes, with or after food is best.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.target_text: Diolch. Alla i gael pecyn… o blasters hefyd?
sentences.known_text: Thank you. Could I also get a packet of plasters?

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Un deg naw. Dau ddeg. Dau ddeg un. Dydd Mercher. Dydd Iau.
sentences.known_text: Nineteen. Twenty. Twenty-one. Wednesday. Thursday.

sentences.speaker: Tourist
sentences.target_text: Esgusodwch fi,… ydych chi'n gwybod… sut i gyrraedd… yr archfarchnad agosaf?
sentences.known_text: Excuse me, do you know how to get to the nearest supermarket?

sentences.speaker: Local
sentences.target_text: Ydw,… mae hi tua deg munud… o waith cerdded. Cerwch yn syth… ar hyd y ffordd 'ma.
sentences.known_text: Yes, it's about a ten minute walk. Go straight along this road.

sentences.speaker: Tourist
sentences.target_text: Heibio i'r eglwys yna?
sentences.known_text: Past that church?

sentences.speaker: Local
sentences.target_text: Ie, heibio i'r eglwys… a'r swyddfa bost.
sentences.known_text: Yes, past the church and the post office.

sentences.speaker: Local
sentences.target_text: Wrth yr ail gylchfan,… cymerwch… yr allanfa gyntaf.
sentences.known_text: At the second roundabout, take the first exit.

sentences.speaker: Tourist
sentences.target_text: A wedyn?
sentences.known_text: And then?

sentences.speaker: Local
sentences.target_text: Fe welwch chi'r archfarchnad… ar eich ochr chwith,… jyst gyferbyn â'r… safle bws.
sentences.known_text: You'll see the supermarket on your left, just opposite the bus stop.

sentences.speaker: Tourist
sentences.target_text: Gwych. Ac oes 'na beiriant arian… gerllaw?
sentences.known_text: Wonderful. And is there a cashpoint nearby?

sentences.speaker: Local
sentences.target_text: Oes, mae un ar y stryd fawr,… wrth ymyl y becws.
sentences.known_text: Yes, there's one on the high street, next to the bakery.

sentences.speaker: Tourist
sentences.target_text: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Dych chi wedi bod yn help mawr.
sentences.known_text: Thank you very much. You've been very helpful.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Tri deg. Pedwar deg. Pum deg. Dydd Gwener. Dydd Sadwrn.
sentences.known_text: Thirty. Forty. Fifty. Friday. Saturday.

sentences.speaker: Passenger
sentences.target_text: Helo. Allwch chi fynd â fi… i'r orsaf drên,… os gwelwch yn dda?
sentences.known_text: Hello. Can you take me to the train station, please?

sentences.speaker: Driver
sentences.target_text: Galla, wrth gwrs. Falle bydd hi'n cymryd… tipyn o amser —… ma lot o draffig… ar hyn o bryd.
sentences.known_text: Yes, of course. Maybe it will take a bit of time — there's a lot of traffic at the moment.

sentences.speaker: Passenger
sentences.target_text: Faint o amser… ydych chi'n meddwl… bydd hi'n gymryd, fwy neu lai?
sentences.known_text: About how long do you think it will take?

sentences.speaker: Driver
sentences.target_text: Falle tua ugain munud,… os byddwn ni… ddim yn anlwcus… gyda'r goleuadau traffig.
sentences.known_text: Perhaps about twenty minutes, if we're not unlucky with the traffic lights.

sentences.speaker: Passenger
sentences.target_text: Ydych chi'n gwbod… ble alla i gael tocyn… yn yr orsaf?
sentences.known_text: Do you know where I can get a ticket in the station?

sentences.speaker: Driver
sentences.target_text: Ydw,… bydda i'n eich gollwng chi… reit wrth y swyddfa docynnau.
sentences.known_text: Yes, I'll drop you right by the ticket office.

sentences.speaker: Driver
sentences.target_text: Dyma ni. Deuddeg punt a hanner yw hi.
sentences.known_text: Here we are. That's twelve pounds fifty.

sentences.speaker: Passenger
sentences.target_text: Alla i dalu… gyda cherdyn?
sentences.known_text: Could I pay by card?

sentences.speaker: Driver
sentences.target_text: Gallwch, wrth gwrs. Ma'r peiriant reit fan hyn.
sentences.known_text: Yes, of course. The machine is right here.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Cant. Dau gant. Mil. Dydd Sul. Deuddeg o'r gloch.
sentences.known_text: One hundred. Two hundred. One thousand. Sunday. Twelve o'clock.

sentences.speaker: Learner
sentences.target_text: Fyddet ti'n meindio… taswn i'n trio ymarfer… siarad Cymraeg gyda ti? Dw i ddim wedi bod… yn dysgu am amser hir iawn… a dw i'n dal i deimlo… ychydig bach yn nerfus… am siarad gyda phobl eraill.
sentences.known_text: Would you mind if I tried to practise speaking Welsh with you? I haven't been learning for very long, and I still feel a little nervous about speaking with other people.

sentences.speaker: Friend
sentences.target_text: Wrth gwrs, dim problem. Ti i'w weld… yn siarad yn dda iawn. Dw i'n gallu… dy ddeall di'n hawdd.
sentences.known_text: Of course, no problem. You seem to speak it very well. I can understand you easily.

sentences.speaker: Learner
sentences.target_text: Diolch, mae'n braf gwybod hynny. Mae angen i fi ddysgu… mwy o eiriau,… ac mae angen i fi… ymarfer gwrando. Dw i ddim yn deall pobl… yn dda iawn… pan nad ydyn nhw'n siarad… yn araf.
sentences.known_text: Thank you, that's good to know. I need to learn more words, and I need to practise listening. I don't understand people very well when they don't speak slowly.

sentences.speaker: Friend
sentences.target_text: Ydw i'n siarad… yn ddigon araf i ti nawr?
sentences.known_text: Am I speaking slowly enough for you now?

sentences.speaker: Learner
sentences.target_text: Wyt, diolch. Mae'n haws siarad gydag… un person yn unig. Mae'n ychydig bach yn anodd meddwl am rywbeth i'w ddweud… cofia. Dw i ddim yn siŵr beth i'w ddweud… ond dw i'n teimlo fel alla i siarad digon i ddechrau cael sgyrsiau.
sentences.known_text: Yes, thank you. It's easier talking to just one person. It's a bit difficult thinking of something to say, though. I'm not sure what to say, but I feel as if I can speak enough to start having conversations.

sentences.speaker: Friend
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n meddwl… dy fod ti'n gwneud… yn dda iawn. Ti wedi creu argraff fawr… arna i. Dw i'n meddwl… dy fod ti'n barod… i ddechrau siarad Cymraeg… gydag unrhyw un… sy'n siarad Cymraeg.
sentences.known_text: I think you're doing very well. I'm impressed. I think you're ready to start speaking Welsh to anyone who speaks Welsh.

sentences.speaker: Learner
sentences.target_text: Mae'n ychydig bach… yn rhwystredig… pan alla i ddim meddwl… yn ddigon cyflym… i fynegi fy hun yn iawn. Ond dw i'n gwybod… bod angen i fi… barhau i ymarfer… os dw i moyn siarad… yn fwy hyderus.
sentences.known_text: It's just a little frustrating when I can't think quickly enough to express myself properly. But I know that I need to keep practising if I want to speak more confidently.

sentences.speaker: Friend
sentences.target_text: Dylet ti fod yn hyderus… yn barod. Dw i'n meddwl… dy fod ti'n gwneud… yn llawer gwell… nag wyt ti'n sylweddoli. Dw i'n… teimlo'n gyfforddus… yn siarad gyda ti,… a dw i ddim yn siarad… yn araf iawn.
sentences.known_text: You should be confident already. I think you're doing much better than you realise. I feel comfortable speaking with you, and I'm not talking very slowly.

sentences.speaker: Learner
sentences.target_text: Dyma'r union fath… o ymarfer… sydd angen arna i. Dw i'n meddwl… galla i deimlo… fe'n newid fy ymennydd i… tra bo ni'n siarad! Dw i'n gwerthfawrogi… dy help di'n fawr iawn. Ond mae'n syndod… pa mor flinedig… dw i'n mynd… pan dw i'n siarad mewn iaith… dw i ddim yn ei siarad… yn dda iawn.
sentences.known_text: This is exactly the kind of practice I need. I think I can feel it changing my brain while we're talking! I really appreciate your help. But it's surprising how tired I get when I'm talking in a language I don't speak very well.

sentences.speaker: Friend
sentences.target_text: Dw i'n meddwl… bod hynny'n normal. Mae dysgu iaith newydd… yn anodd. Ond mae'n gymaint o hwyl… pan wyt ti'n… dechrau cael sgyrsiau,… on'd yw e?
sentences.known_text: I think that's normal. Learning a new language is difficult. But it's so much fun when you start to have conversations, isn't it?

sentences.speaker: Learner
sentences.target_text: Ydy, wir. Dw i'n hapus iawn… fy mod i'n gallu cael… cymaint â hyn o sgwrs. A dw i'n gobeithio… y byddwn ni'n gallu cael… mwy o sgyrsiau… yn y dyfodol… wrth i fi barhau i wella.
sentences.known_text: It really is. I'm really happy that I can have this much of a conversation. And I hope we'll be able to have more conversations in the future as I keep on getting better.

sentences.speaker: Narrator
sentences.target_text: Can mil. Chwe deg. Saith deg. Un o'r gloch. Un ar ddeg o'r gloch.
sentences.known_text: One hundred thousand. Sixty. Seventy. One o'clock. Eleven o'clock.
